name: rust-manifest-discovery
body: Rust frontend manifest discovery: find all Cargo manifests under the scan root, load each project/workspace (rust-analyzer ProjectManifest/ProjectWorkspace), dedupe workspace members by manifest root, and merge the emitted facts. Fixes the discover_single gap that leaves src/rustlib (a separate Cargo project) out of the graph. Source is src/rustlib/src/main.rs (load_workspace_at / discover_single), which is not yet in the scanned graph — the plan declares it as a planned Implementation node, and this component's `implemented-by` anchor is that planned File node (its FQN is the file's absolute path), graded Pending until the branch re-scan realizes it.
